content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jennifer Martin (E033), requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR note: role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation Payroll: write. Full-time employees max write unless role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Payroll (Payroll Specialist owns it). So max write.
- Security note: role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation Payroll: read. Security DB is authoritative. Contractors with basic training max out at read; never admin.

The security note says security record is authoritative. So employment type is contractor with basic training. Max access = read. Requested admin > max, so grant max = read.

Submit decision: read.
